description:
## Makerere University Business School (MUBS) - Health Services Center

**Makerere University Business School (MUBS)** is one of Uganda's leading business education institutions, located in **Nakawa, Kampala**. The MUBS Health Services Center provides healthcare services to students, staff and the surrounding community.

The Health Services Center is currently looking for a suitably qualified **Part Time Medical Officer** to join the team.

## About the Role

The Part Time Medical Officer will provide medical consultation, diagnosis and treatment services at the MUBS Health Services Center. The role is designed for medical professionals who are available for limited hours and want a flexible part-time engagement in an academic institution setting.

## Working Hours

- No more than **60 or 80 hours per month**, at the discretion of the HR Department
- The exact number of hours will be determined based on the needs of the Health Center and the availability of the successful candidate

## Salary

- Competitive remuneration at approximately **UGX 31,000 per hour**
- For 60 hours per month this equates to approximately UGX 1,860,000 per month
- For 80 hours per month this equates to approximately UGX 2,480,000 per month

## Key Responsibilities

- Provide medical consultation, diagnosis and treatment to patients presenting at the Health Services Center
- Take patient histories, conduct physical examinations and order relevant investigations
- Prescribe appropriate medications and treatment plans
- Refer patients to specialists or higher-level facilities when cases exceed the scope of the health center
- Provide health education and preventive care advice to patients
- Maintain accurate and confidential patient medical records and files
- Participate in health promotion and wellness activities within the MUBS community
- Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards
- Respond to medical emergencies and provide first aid as required
- Collaborate with other health staff at the center to ensure quality service delivery
- Advise the administration on health-related policies and student wellness matters

## Qualifications and Requirements

- **MBChB** degree from a recognised institution
- Must be registered with the **Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council (UMDPC)**
- Valid practising licence
- Experience in general medical practice is preferred
- Good clinical skills and ability to work independently
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to handle a wide range of general medical conditions
- Knowledge of student health issues is an added advantage

## How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit the following:

- Formal application letter addressed to:

  **The Ag. School Doctor**
  Makerere University Business School
  Health Care Services Center
  P.O. Box 1337
  Kampala, Uganda

- **RE:** Application for the job of Part Time Medical Officer at MUBS Health Center
- Updated CV
- Copies of academic documents and certificates
- Proof of UMDPC registration

### Submission Methods

📧 **Email:** health@mubs.ac.ug
   CC: dmugarura@mubs.ac.ug

🏢 **Physical delivery:** MUBS Health Care Services Center, Nakawa, Kampala

### Deadline

All applications must be received by **28th August 2026 at 5:00pm**.

### Interview Process

Applications will be vetted and candidates considered for a physical interview will be notified.

**Dr. Mugarura Denis Robinson**
Ag. School Doctor
Makerere University Business School Health Services Center
